item.title: - All Group Representation is Equivalent to Unitary Representation
item.description: Introduction # In this article, we will prove that all group representations are equivalent to unitary representations. This is a fundamental result in representation theory with important applications in physics and mathematics. Definitions and Background # Equivalence of Representations: Two representations $A$ and $B$ are equivalent if and only if there exists an invertible matrix $X$ such that: $$A = XBX^{-1}$$ Hermitian Operators: A key property we’ll use is that all Hermitian operators are diagonalizable.
